name: plexus-workspace
author: Pragmatic Lab <evgen.napryaglo@gmail.com>
description: Plexus monorepo — shared plexus-core package + Electron apps (plexus, devUI).

scripts.build:plexus: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @pragmatic-tech-ai/plexus
scripts.build:devui: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @pragmatic-tech-ai/devui
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @pragmatic-tech-ai/plexus --if-present && npm run build -w @pragmatic-tech-ai/devui --if-present
